kind: Exhaustive indexed seven-block classification for all a>=1, two actual weighted Fano forms, and the known exact family C(7a+4,3a+2,2)=7
reuse_scope: SevenBlock.Core contains the general a>=2 branch and both constructions without Stanton. SevenBlock adds only the a=1 ordinary/indexed adapter. Templates retain actual point fibres, including the empty Type-II fibre at a=1. Universal proofs do not use a diagnostic catalogue or external certificate.
path_convention: Paths are relative to the repository root. All public Lean sources and audit sources are fingerprinted by the shared workflow.
